snippet.title: Last Moon - Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
As announced during PC Gaming Show, Last Moon's demo is now available on Steam, check it out: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1108600/Last_Moon/

Last Moon is an action RPG that pays homage to the classics of the 90s. Step into the shoes of a Lunar Knight and traverse a vast, ruined world, confront tainted creatures and upgrade your abilities in your quest to restore peace.

Follow all the news regarding the game on X: https://x.com/lastmoongame
